budget.note: 128 is the number of tools the Copilot agent-mode client can enable at once. Tool definitions are loaded into every request, so the token estimate below is a recurring cost, not a one-off cost. Counts marked estimated are vendor-documented figures, not measurements taken by this extension. Every shipped preset stays at or below 12 toolkit tools and leaves at least 20 tools of headroom.

presets.label: Read and cite a document
presets.goal: Open one workspace PDF, DOCX or Markdown file, read bounded text with page or paragraph locators, and write a cited Markdown or DOCX report.
tips: Smallest surface: four tools, so the assistant almost always picks the right one.
Use this when you are working on a single source, not searching a corpus.
requires: Managed worker installed in this workspace

presets.label: Search my own notes
presets.goal: Find passages across the Markdown and text files you select in this workspace, then reopen the matching passage with its paragraph provenance.
tips: Search results are local BM25 hits with file and line provenance; no index file is written.
read_text_source reopens a hit with adjacent paragraphs; read_document handles PDF and DOCX instead.
requires: Managed worker installed in this workspace

presets.label: Verify a citation
presets.goal: Check that a DOI resolves against Crossref and compare candidate references from the OpenAlex, Crossref and Semantic Scholar providers.
tips: An unresolved DOI is not proof that a citation is wrong; it means Crossref did not return it.
Network access to the public metadata APIs is required.
requires: Managed worker installed in this workspace
Network access to public metadata APIs

presets.label: Prepare a Zotero import
presets.goal: Collect references, read your Zotero collections and items, and create a new RIS file under research/imports/ for a manual import you review.
tips: Nothing is written to Zotero: the toolkit only creates a RIS file you import yourself.
Zotero must be running with its localhost API enabled for the collection and item tools.
requires: Managed worker installed in this workspace
Zotero localhost API for the Zotero tools

presets.label: Read, search, cite and write
presets.goal: The complete document and metadata surface in one preset: local document reading and search, scholarly metadata, Zotero reading, and cited report writing. No corpus index or record store.
tips: Recommended default: nine tools, well inside the range where tool selection stays reliable.
Choose corpus-lab or research-workflow when you need the stored index and claims.
requires: Managed worker installed in this workspace
Network access for the metadata tools
Zotero localhost API for the Zotero tools

presets.label: Full research workflow (index, evidence, claims)
presets.goal: The continuous Full journey in one preset: read a source, index the sources you select, retrieve a passage, resolve the evidence behind it, record a claim linked to that evidence, and write a cited report.
tips: Full default: eleven toolkit tools, inside the 12-tool release budget and far below the 128-tool client ceiling.
The index and claims live in .research-toolkit/store/research.sqlite3 in this workspace; source files are never modified.
Lexical BM25 only: no embeddings, no vector search and no third-party database are installed by this preset.
requires: Managed worker installed in this workspace
Corpus index and record store step completed

presets.label: Documents, citations and third-party evidence
presets.goal: The document and citation surface plus the GitHub and Playwright servers many research workflows use for repository and browser evidence. No corpus index or record store.
tips: Third-party counts are vendor-published estimates, not measurements taken by this extension.
Above about 50 enabled tools, assistants start choosing less reliably.
For the stored index and claims use research-workflow or corpus-lab instead.

thirdParty.note: Core browser toolset without network, storage, testing, vision or devtools caps.

presets.label: Maximum research lab (128-tool budget)
presets.goal: Widest supported surface: the document and citation toolkit plus GitHub, Playwright and a Zotero community server, kept under the 128-tool client ceiling with headroom for future tools.
tips: This preset is close to the client ceiling; prefer a narrower preset for routine tasks.
Headroom is deliberate: new toolkit verbs in 0.3.5 must not push the surface over 128.

presets.label: Index, search and record claims
presets.goal: Index the Markdown, text, PDF or DOCX sources you select, search that stored corpus with page or paragraph provenance, resolve evidence, check that the indexed files are still the files on disk, and keep each claim linked to the exact chunks that support it.
tips: The index and claims live in .research-toolkit/store/research.sqlite3 in this workspace; source files are never modified.
A PDF chunk carries its original page number and offsets in that page's extracted text; a DOCX chunk carries its ordered paragraph or table-row item. A chunk never crosses a page or an item.

verify_sources is the only verb that may call a source verified: it re-hashes the present file. A source nobody checked stays 'unchecked'. unindex_corpus and store_maintenance are destructive: a restore is staged as a candidate first and vacuum needs confirmation.
Lexical BM25 only: no embeddings, no vector search and no third-party database are installed by this preset.
requires: Managed worker installed in this workspace
Corpus index and record store step completed
